calls.title: Ben Schlessman and Cary Rakin
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the renewal and seat management strategy for Line Studios, emphasizing the need for flexibility in seat usage due to fluctuating demands from active users, which exceeded the current contract limit of 50 seats. Cary Rakin identified the necessity of a creative solution to accommodate approximately 50 to 70 internal users and 30 to 50 external read-only users. The preferred payment model discussed was a pay-as-you-go system, facilitating growth without imposing strict seat caps. Additionally, GrowthBook's integration primarily for AB testing was reviewed, with insights into user management, access control, and technical analytics, while the need for improved invite tracking was acknowledged. Cary proposed gathering feedback and scheduling a roadmap call to align on future developments.
calls.keywords: User seat management, external users, read-only access, licensing flexibility, GrowthBook integration, product analytics beta
calls.action_items:
**Chris Sanders**
Check if it is possible to provide information on who invited users via API or audit logs and explore adding invite event logging (00:14)

**Cary Rakin**
Investigate flexible pricing/licensing models that accommodate fluctuating and mixed user seat types (50+ full-time, read-only for external users) ensuring no disruption of service (07:53)
Coordinate with Lion Studios for a product roadmap call to discuss new features including product analytics and AI focus (18:45)
Make an announcement in Slack channel for team feedback and questions regarding platform usage and enablement needs to improve engagement (15:29)

**Ben Schlessman**
Continue commercial communication and coordination with Cary primarily through Slack and phone as needed (14:30)
